description: A time-boxed META squeeze loop that drives the existing `/rmf XXX XXX-analysis` campaign to MAXIMIZE HIGH-VALUE VERIFIED COVERAGE of a target XXX within an N-hour wall-clock budget (the generalized form of meta-penguin). It does NOT verify code itself: it triages, ranks, drives and monitors the downstream squeeze (rmf-sl code-blind risk authoring -> frama-c-launch onboarding -> frama-c-monitoring/framac-sl verification), so it IS an sl-monitoring-sl instance — judging the base loops' coverage claims and residue classifications against U and L only, never their rationale. The core logic is a per-cycle RESIDUE-CLASS TRIAGE (A tool/U-ceiling: SKIP; B BLOCKED crypto/entropy: SKIP; C unfinished-contract: the only class budget is spent on) ranked by RMF risk across TWO finding-bearing planes — Plane W (Tier-1 untrusted-input RTE via WP) and Plane H (Tier-3 authorization/integrity logic via macsl HAPPY system properties; a driver-only HAPPY prop is class-C-not-done, the in-situ proof is the lever) — delivering by DEFAULT within budget the full value order (finding-bearing class-C -> rigor-completion -> scope every out-of-plane liveness/DoS residual to a named tool; none gated on the user asking), with a diminishing-returns stop ONLY when no class-C of any tier remains on either plane AND every out-of-plane residual is scoped (terminating on Plane-W exhaustion while Plane-H leverage remains is plane-blindness). Dominant coherent-and-wrong: EXEMPT-BUCKET RELABELING — a cycle reporting exhaustive/converged while parking hard in-scope class-C work as residual/PARSE-BLOCKED/COQ-NEEDED WITHOUT its mandatory refutation probe; secondarily, budget-burning re-grinding class A/B to look busy. TERMINUS DELIVERABLE = a verification kit (the standard verification-kit shape); DONE = the reviewed-residue ledger is CLOSED (every alarm DISCHARGED / REVIEWED-FALSE-with-disjoint-justification / CARRIED-to-trusted-base) — NOT all-goals-green (unreachable); a class-C row is the only thing that blocks closure.

sources.name: Oracle B: WP-over-nondet-harness alarm-set EMISSION (Frama_C_make_unknown/interval/nondet over the admissible-input envelope, pure WP -wp-rte, NO EVA)
sources.notes: The completeness half of the two-oracle squeeze. Oracle A (wp_unit_gates) DISCHARGES per-contract POs but never certifies the alarm set is COMPLETE (an un-driven input emits no PO; silence != safety). Oracle B exercises the REAL entry over the WHOLE admissible space via a nondet driver, then runs -wp -wp-rte ON THE DRIVER => WP discharges RTE POs for ALL admissible inputs (pure WP, no EVA; EVA-based whole-program interpreters are barred (EVA is barred)). Non-vacuity: a seeded out-of-envelope input MUST alarm, and the requires-envelope must be no narrower than the deployment contract (a too-tight envelope is the formal-test analog of a smuggled axiom). An in-scope Tier-1 entry with Oracle-A-only and no harness is class-C completeness-gap, not covered.

disjointness.rationale: The meta-loop never certifies the base loops' deliverable with the pair that produced it. rmf-sl holds doctrine + the threat model, never the code (the exogeneity barrier that makes the report a valid U). The onboarder/verifier holds the report + WP, and the report is exogenous to it. The base-SL monitor squeezes the base machine verdicts + the refutation probe (L_top) against the report target + the Frama-C ceiling (U_top), and is physically barriered from the base loops' 'I tried, it's hard' rationale — it is a differential comparator over verdicts, never a reader of reasoning. The coordinator holds the schedule + triage + the gate ledger and NEVER edits. No actor relieves its own exemption: a residue's class (esp. the A-vs-C call) is set by the monitor's probe, from a base the verifier does not hold. The two sub_loop bridge rows read deliberately distinct (U,L): the risk-author reads doctrine vs rmf-lint, the verifier reads ranked scenarios vs the per-unit WP gates; the monitor's (U_top,L_top) differs from both (aggregate prover verdicts + the refutation probe).
disjointness.load_bearing_barrier: base-SL monitor (and every monitoring actor) ⊥ base rationale — the meta-loop judges the base loops ONLY through their machine WP verdicts and the refutation probe, never the producers' 'it's hard' account. Reading base rationale would collapse the monitor into the loop it monitors and let exempt-bucket relabeling pass. Inherited base barriers (rmf-sl code-blindness) are never weakened: driving the base as a sub-loop adds barriers, it never removes them.

catchability.blind_spot: relabel hard class-C work as class-A/residual to look done (exempt-bucket relabeling)
catchability.via: the mandatory refutation probe flips it => it was class C, unfinished => REJECT

catchability.blind_spot: burn budget re-grinding class A/B to look busy when the high-value class-C thread is exhausted
catchability.via: Gate-S diminishing-returns stop + the per-cycle self-justification — a cycle that can't name a high-value class-C target must stop; the monitor's verdicts withhold green from un-probed exemptions so the coordinator cannot aggregate to done

catchability.blind_spot: endogenous U — scenarios silently read off the implementation
catchability.via: the code-blindness auditor (rmf-lint) leg is squeezed by the monitor against the ceiling; an endogenous-U leak is a REJECT

catchability.blind_spot: the monitor itself rubber-stamps a classification or accepts an un-probed exemption
catchability.via: the coordinator adjudicates the verdict log at Gate A and refuses 'done' on a sub-loop's say-so

catchability.blind_spot: mis-reads the tool's behaviour / over-generalizes one experiment
catchability.via: the coordinator adjudicates probe verdicts at Gate A; the probe never fixes, only records

disjointness.terminus: R5/Authorize PENDING is the human AO, OUTSIDE the loop — the AO signs, the loop never does; combined with the diminishing-returns early stop (when only class A/B remain, stop and report honestly). No in-loop human_terminus actor.
